job_description:
Meridian Insurance Technology is hiring a Software Engineer to build internal automation and document processing services. The engineer will maintain Python applications, expose services through APIs, work with relational databases, and deploy services into the company's container platform.

Candidates must have at least four years of professional software engineering experience. Strong Python programming skills are required. Experience designing and maintaining REST APIs is required. Candidates must be comfortable working with relational databases and writing SQL.

Experience with Docker is important. Kubernetes experience is preferred. Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP is preferred. The team also values experience with automated testing, code review, and production monitoring.

Benefits, paid leave, and equal-opportunity language are described separately and are not qualifications.

Software engineer with five years of professional experience developing Python applications and REST services. Designs APIs, writes complex SQL for PostgreSQL, and supports schema migrations. Uses Docker for local and production packaging and writes pytest-based unit and integration tests.

Has deployed applications to Azure App Service and Azure Container Apps. Has not administered Kubernetes clusters but has read deployment manifests and worked with a platform team that manages Kubernetes.

job_description:
Helix Bioinformatics is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to develop predictive models for biological datasets and collaborate with scientists on model evaluation and deployment. The engineer will build reproducible training pipelines, analyze model performance, and help package models for internal use.

A master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field is required, or equivalent professional experience may be considered. Candidates must have at least three years of applied machine-learning experience. Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with scikit-learn or PyTorch are required.

Candidates should understand cross-validation, class imbalance, and model calibration. Experience with biological or healthcare data is preferred. Experience using MLflow or another experiment-tracking system is preferred. Publications are welcome but are not required.

The company provides standard benefits and a hybrid schedule.
resume_text:
Machine learning engineer with six years of professional experience and a B.S. in Applied Mathematics. Builds classification and regression models in Python using scikit-learn and PyTorch. Regularly uses cross-validation, class-weighting methods, calibration curves, and threshold analysis. Uses MLflow for experiment tracking.

Most professional work has been in retail forecasting and customer analytics, with no biological or healthcare datasets. Has no graduate degree.

Experience using a commercial pharmacy management system is important. At least two years of community pharmacy experience is preferred. Spanish-language proficiency is preferred because the store serves a large bilingual population.
